fields.label: From %
fields.description: Achievement at or above this earns the slab. Inclusive at the bottom and exclusive at the top, so a rep at exactly 80% lands in the 80 slab and in no other - the one boundary every incentive argument is about.

fields.label: Open Ended
fields.description: The top slab has no ceiling. Without one, a rep at 140% against a table that stops at 120 earns nothing at all, which is the opposite of what anybody intended.

fields.label: Amount
fields.description: Flat rupees for hitting the slab. Read only where the kind is Fixed Amount.

fields.label: Percent
fields.description: Of the actual value achieved, not of the target. Paying a percentage of the target would pay the same to a rep at 81% and one at 119%.

fields.label: Called
fields.description: What the rep sees on the phone - Tier 1, Gold. A slab shown as a percent range is a slab nobody repeats in the canteen.
